faq.title: The questions we get, answered plainly.

q1.q: Will an AI redraw my logo?
q1.a: No. The logo is never redrawn by a generative model. Variants and mockups are computed from your file.

q2.a: Charta does the systematic part: palette, contrasts, variants, layout, files. Direction stays yours: every page can be edited by hand or with the copilot, and you judge the result.

q3.a: The logo is sanitised, stays private and is only readable from your project. You keep your rights on your logos.

q4.a: No: it is an RGB reference PDF with vector text and logos. It is not presented as print-ready.

q5.a: SVG (up to 5 MB), PNG, WebP or JPEG (up to 10 MB and 8,192 × 8,192 px). An SVG with unconverted text is flagged: export it with text outlined.

q6.q: Can I try it without an account, and what does it cost?
q6.a: Yes: a guest session lets you test. The free plan offers 3 projects. Paid plans are not open yet and their prices are indicative.

pricing.a1: An SVG logo (5 MB at most), PNG, WebP or JPEG (10 MB and 8192 × 8192 px at most). The file is checked before it is read.
pricing.q2: Do my files belong to me?
pricing.a2: You keep your rights on your logos. The terms on generated texts and layouts will be set out in the terms of use, worded with care.
